EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows a broad, weak band at 3309 cm⁻¹ consistent with an O–H stretch (GFQ-001), numerous strong aliphatic C–H stretches at 2879–3065 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-003), and multiple intense bands in the 800–1250 cm⁻¹ region (826, 880, 1026, 1137, 1226, 1247 cm⁻¹) characteristic of C–O and C–O–C vibrations of cyclic ethers/acetals. Candidate 9 contains an OH and multiple ring oxygens (dioxolane/oxetane-like), matching these features. Amine-containing candidates would typically show NH bending near 1600–1650 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-002), which is not observed, disfavoring them.
